projectionPriority: FanGraphs 2026 Trade Value Series ZiPS update where published
ZiPS future + ZiPS role-aware rolling talent update

seasonUpdate.method: Calibrated end-of-season update: Marcel-style three-season WAR rate plus the share of ZiPS information beyond it (k=0.575 hitters, 0.628 pitchers, fit on 2026), applied at ZiPS playing time; carried into later seasons at 0.85 per year. Pitcher roles follow 2026 usage. Only players with at least 100 PA or 20 IP in 2026 are updated; players with Trade Value Series projections are unchanged.

ageCorrection.method: Aging-model base ages set from FanGraphs season age (age on June 30) in the most recent 2023-26 season, advanced to 2027. The refresh had added a year to the current age from RosterResource, which made about a third of players a year too old.
ageCorrection.note: Only one-year-too-old cases were corrected; two players whose FanGraphs age disagreed in the other direction were left as they were.
